responsibility: Defines the Epiphany backend’s operand predicates used by recog and md patterns to classify legal RTL operands beyond simple constraints. It describes valid symbolic call/jump targets, GPR and add-register classes, arithmetic immediates, move sources and destinations, stack-top and misaligned memory forms, CC and FP comparison operators for the target’s custom CC modes, floating-point operation shape after mode-switch USE insertion, FP-mode setters, and post-modify addressing. This file therefore owns the semantic operand tests that distinguish which RTL forms each Epiphany pattern may match.
